composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make a celadon porcelain gecko viewed slightly from above, with an arcing tail and four relaxed feet spread into clear five-toed shapes. The body lies diagonally while its head turns gently toward the viewer. Use softly faceted ceramic surfaces and a few darker glaze pools along the spine, avoiding realistic scales. Set it against warm off-white with a fine shadow, allowing its graceful curved silhouette to carry the composition. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
